core_meaning.primary_meaning: Firdevs is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Paradise”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Firdevs corresponds to the Arabic form فردوس (Arabic فردوس (firdaws), Turkish form Firdevs). Its core sense is paradise, garden. Firdevs is the Turkish form of Arabic فردوس (firdaws) 'paradise'. The source gloss 'jewel, treasure' is wrong for this form — that sense belongs to Persian گوهر (gawhar), a different word — and has not been carried over. Turkish naming usage is predominantly (though not exclusively) feminine.
